overview: Dr Karl lifts the lid on how some of Australia's best loved products are made, stepping behind factory lines to uncover the intricate workings of some of our most productive manufacturing plants.
title: Dr Karl's How Things Work

overview: Captain Petko Vojvoda is a Bulgarian historical drama series that chronicles the life and struggles of Petko Kiryakov, a 19th-century freedom fighter and defender of Bulgarian and Balkan independence. The series portrays his battles against Ottoman oppression, his leadership of a militia, and his dedication to justice and the liberation of his people. It highlights themes of patriotism, sacrifice, and resilience in the face of adversity.
title: Kapitan Petko Voyvoda

overview: Follows 11 NWSL players as they spend two weeks in Miami training, living together, and providing uncensored access into their personal lives, rivalries, and on-field journey.
title: The Offseason

overview: A sailor is murdered on a freighter of the Swiss merchant navy. Inspector Aurélie travels to Cape Town and is supposed to bring the main suspect Florian home. But he protests his innocence and looks for his girlfriend Julia, who was traveling incognito as a passenger. On the high seas, Aurélie tries to uncover the truth.
title: Auf hoher See

overview: Playing Gracie Darling is set in a place where everyone knows each other, secrets are buried deep, and where being different is impossible to hide. When Joni was 14, her best friend Gracie Darling disappeared during a séance and hasn't been seen since. Twenty-seven years on, Joni is a child psychologist and has never forgiven herself for Gracie's disappearance. Joni is haunted by her past when she receives a startling call from her childhood friend Jay, now a local cop, alerting her that another Darling girl has disappeared during a seance.
title: Playing Gracie Darling

overview: Host Tony Armstrong - with the help of scientists, land carers, an artist and a chef - will attempt to turn our unwanted ecological trash into desirable culinary gold, in a provocative attempt to Eat the Invaders.
title: Eat The Invaders

overview: Enhanced episodes of "The First 48," with bonus content and never-before-seen scenes.
title: The First 48: Room Full of Lies

overview: Thomas Jefferson is widely considered the patron saint of America's most sacred beliefs. He is the central figure in the story of American democracy and when he penned the Declaration of Independence nearly 250 years ago, he personally inspired a revolution of self-governance around the world. More so than John Adams, Alexander Hamilton or even Abraham Lincoln, it was Jefferson's "revolution of ideas" that laid the groundwork for America's founding and success. As our 3rd president, Jefferson doubled the size of the country and inspired a western expansion that turned a fledgling nation into an empire. Jefferson's image as an American deity would be almost perfect… were it not for slavery. Although his immeasurable contributions to American freedom and growth have been well documented, the complexities of his relationship with slavery, which include a decades-long sexual relationship with an enslaved woman and the children who came from it, have remained largely misrepresented in the popular American narrative. THOMAS JEFFERSON is a 6×60 premium documentary series and the first of its kind to take an objective and comprehensive approach to the truly remarkable and surprising story of an American icon.
title: Thomas Jefferson

overview: Seeking revenge after being framed for murder 14 years ago, Sachiko changes her appearance and infiltrates a popular influencer's home as a babysitter.
title: Hell For You

overview: A collection of true crime documentaries that cover a range of real-life offences and notorious offenders.

overview: Xu Cheng is a full-time housewife whose husband, Lu Yan, is an attending physician at a private hospital. They have been married for five years, and they have an adorable daughter named Lu Jiajia. One year ago, Xu Cheng started having trouble sleeping, which is getting serious day after day. The occasional hallucination has also caused her to hurt herself and others. However, a car accident brings a change to this once-perfect marriage. Lu Yan, whose car is now in the lake water, is fortunately enough to be saved by some passerby. Xu Cheng, on the other hand, is missing.
title: Rising from the Ashes

overview: The Cangyun Goddess Jiang Zhiyu and the young tanuki from the Li clan, Jiang Jinghuai, fell in love after getting to know each other. However, due to their difference in social status, their relationship was opposed by Nangong Xiao, the leader of the Cangyun clan. He set a trap to turn their love into hatred. Yet, as the two continued to be entangled with each other, they gradually uncovered the truth. Their genuine love resolved the conflict and ultimately saved the world.

overview: Each one-hour episode of Cold Justice: Inside the Episode features never-before-seen details about one investigation previously chronicled on COLD JUSTICE. Every story has behind-the-scenes facts, insights from Kelly Siegler, and often jaw-dropping allegations that hit the cutting room floor the first time around. Now, these special episodes bring those facts to life.
title: Cold Justice: Inside the Episode

overview: The series revolves around Seher, a resilient 20-year-old from Rajasthan, who dares to dream beyond the confines of her circumstances. Fueled by ambition and a determination to redefine her destiny, Seher journeys to Mumbai, the city of dreams, but soon discovers its darker, grittier side. She dreams of becoming the best prostitute in Mumbai's infamous red light district, Kamathipura. However, her journey isn't that easy. Seher has stepped into Qadir Khan's den and now its a fight to survive. Will Seher fulfil her dreams and fight against the King of Kamathipura?
title: Chidiya Udd

overview: CNN Original Series Lockerbie: The Bombing of Pan Am 103 tracks the mysterious circumstances behind the deadliest terror attack on the United States before 9/11. This gripping and emotional series examines the 1988 bombing of Pan Am flight 103 over Lockerbie, Scotland resulting in the death of 270 people, including 190 Americans. The series features heartrending interviews with Lockerbie residents and family members of the passengers who detail their personal experiences of the tragic event. It deftly tracks the complex web of theories that emerged during the global investigation that followed, and the unprecedented trial that played out on the world stage. Though a conviction was upheld in 2000, questions remain about those responsible for one of the most extreme terrorist acts on the United States in history. Weaving together poignant testimony from family members of the Pan Am 103 passengers and exclusive first-hand analysis from investigators, intelligence officers and other key witnesses who have not spoken until now, Lockerbie is the definitive telling of the 1988 tragedy and the ongoing search for conclusive answers on who is responsible.
title: Lockerbie: The Bombing of Pan Am 103

overview: Wynne & Joanna: All at Sea follows Wynne Evans and Joanna Page as the duo embark on a fun-filled journey along the Welsh coastline. Fuelled by their friendship, and shared passions of the sea, food and love of adventure, in each episode we'll join the pair on board as they explore the spectacular Welsh coastline by sea. In this heart-warming series, they'll discover everything from secret coves to seafood recipes, famous ports to fabulous people and we'll get a sneak peek into the lives of two of Wales' most beloved stars.
title: Wynne & Joanna: All at Sea

overview: Colin and Justin's Sub-Zero Reno puts Colin and Justin in completely new renovation territory. Having purchased a dilapidated cabin on a picturesque blue lake — beautiful in summer, but harsh in the cold months - the couple have their work cut out for them. They must transform an ugly duckling property (and former storage facility for their many projects) into their dream home amidst the unforgiving Canadian winter, where temperatures plummet to minus 40 degrees Celsius. The series showcases the relentless pursuit of perfection as the designers face numerous obstacles, including blizzards, dangerous roads, and a rapidly ticking clock. From fraught deliveries and icy conditions to the custom designs required for the new space, every step of the renovation is pressure-filled. But the two are no stranger to adversity and are determined to overcome delays, unpredictable weather and their own demanding personalities.
title: Colin and Justin's Sub-Zero Reno

overview: Radio Wales's Wynne Evans and his dog Ginny delve into the BBC Wales archives of the 1980s to share memorable moments, music and nostalgia.
title: Wynne's Welsh 80s

overview: Victoire is a medical secretary and part-time graphic designer. She lives a quiet life in the suburbs with her husband, two teenagers, and her brother, who stays in a cabin in their backyard. But when her husband is badly injured at work, Victoire discovers they are drowning in debt. She hides a secret from her past, a talent : a gift for forgery that once got her into serious trouble in her youth. Desperate to avoid financial ruin, she teams up with her brother to start a forgery business. While thrilling at first, their operation soon attracts the attention of real criminals, including the dangerous and mysterious Edith.

overview: Love, secrets, and unexpected twists—meet the couples navigating the unpredictable journey of romance in this lively drama. Following the intertwined, rhythmic paths of three couples—three men and three women—exploring the pursuit of happiness in youth and balance in later years.

overview: Enamorándonos is a live dating/matchmaking format that was originally popularized in Turkey. The show brings people from all walks of life together for one common purpose: to find love! Love is in the air has encouraged and coached countless couples seeking rewarding relationships and happy homes since its debut. Candidates who are looking to find their perfect match apply to the show and join the live studio show. The viewers at home who are interested in knowing these candidates call into the studio to meet them. At the studio, they meet for the first time on a blind date, and talk through an automated wall. Hopefully, there is a spark once the wall is withdrawn. But if not, the candidate goes back to the show to continue looking for true love.

overview: For The Fellas has become a cultural touchpoint, providing Black men with a safe and authentic space to engage in raw, unfiltered conversations. overview: When winter slams into the highways of the American Rockies, heavy recovery specialists from four companies race into action, working to clear wrecks and open roads. Whether it's a raging fire or toxic spill, crews roll up ready to battle the wreckage. They've got the equipment and the skills. But with more than a million people depending on the route that crosses these three states every day, the one thing they don't have, is time.

overview: Star chef Mark Levinsky is being fired from a top restaurant in the capital due to his insistence. Moreover, now no one from the restaurant business wants to deal with him. The only way out is to open your own place with an aspiring chef, Aaron, whom Mark has known for the first day, and put all this metropolitan tinsel under your belt. In search of investors, the newly minted colleagues find themselves in debt to the Serbian mafia and are now forced to protect themselves and their loved ones.
title: Жар

overview: Nails tells the story of Lina, Vanessa, Irene and Marilís, four women from different backgrounds and of different ages who meet in a nail salon. Their repeated encounters spark a unique friendship, turning them into partners in crime and influencing the most important decision of their lives: to rebel against their reality and reject who they have become. What happened to their right to choose? Are they victims of what is expected of them? This non-conformism, paired with a feeling of sisterhood, leads the protagonists to create ‘The Free Women's Club' - a safe space intended to help other women solve their problems.
title: Nails

overview: ITV's acclaimed drama series Unforgotten fictionalises a modern-day police team investigating cold case murders and gradually unravelling long-forgotten secrets. Now this new programme from the BAFTA - and multi-award-winning Brinkworth Productions delivers the real thing - with full access to the investigation for the last six years, this series follows a police unit as they bring one of the most intractable murder cases from the past to justice. Just like the drama, the officers never forget that at the core of a murder investigation is the saddest human tragedy. Completely embedded in the unit, the programmes witness the case as it unfolds in front of us - we are there as detectives pick their way through the dead ends and frail memories to discover the truth; we are with them as they target and arrest the suspects; we are in the room as they plan the whole interrogation process, including how they tackle the lies and inconsistencies they have found. Stage by stage and hour by hour, we see every major step of the way as justice is finally served. In what may be potentially a first, the films have access not just to the whole police investigation, but also their meetings with the CPS and with their King's Counsel as they discuss how and when to get the suspects to charge and court. Taking viewers inside a world where no crime is truly forgotten - and no stone is left unturned - this series is truly The Real Unforgotten.
title: The Real Unforgotten

overview: Slayers: Wheel of Fate follows 10 queer competitors as they embark on an "immersive gaming experience." This show is going to take place inside a mysterious castle. Good reality TV happens inside castles.

overview: Endo Kiyomi is a single mother living in a town at the foot of Mt. Fuji in Yamanashi Prefecture. She works at a business hotel. One day, she happens to meet an alien. If she was a pure-hearted girl, she would probably try to develop a friendship with the alien and fight against injustice in the world, but she's a little different. As an adult, she has experienced good and bad in the world. She asks the alien to solve minor events at her work or in her personal life without upsetting the alien.

overview: Tripper's Day is a British television sitcom produced by Thames Television for ITV. The plot involved Leonard Rossiter as Norman Tripper, a Northern manager assigned to a London supermarket with a problematic staff. The programme is largely remembered for the negative critical reviews it received, and mainly for the fact that it was Rossiter's final television work, the actor dying between the broadcast of the second and third episodes. The series was brought back two years later with Bruce Forsyth in the lead role, under the new title Slinger's Day. In Canada and United States the series had a remake under the title Check it Out! (1985–1988).
title: Tripper's Day

overview: Tokiko's mother died 20 years ago and her father Tetsuya is now in his 70's. Her father has a free spirit and is cute. Tokiko is in her mid 40's and still single. She has a strong personality. In their past, Tokiko and Tetsuya did not have a good relationship. It got so bad that they almost ended their relationship, but now they occasionally meet. They go out to eat together and have conversations. Tokiko decides to publish an essay about her father Tetsuya. To collect information for her essay, she meets Tetsuya and listens to various stories, but it's not just pleasant memories.

overview: Vitya, a young charlatan psychic, has a gift for scamming desperate people out of their money. While his conversations with "ghosts of the dead" provide him with a luxurious lifestyle, Vitya's conscience remains silent. However, luck cannot last forever, and Vitya is approached by Sasha, a blogger who aspires to expose him. However, it seems that the "psychic" has begun to see spirits for real. Vitya doesn't quite understand what to do with the ghosts that have fallen on his head, but Sasha does. Now she has a real chance to create a sensational video.

overview: Lera is a sought-after obstetrician who works with the most prestigious patients, but her personal life has become unbearably difficult. After her husband's death, she is forced to raise three children alone. Despite this, Lera copes equally well both as a mother and as an obstetrician. But at some point, she still loses control over herself, which becomes one of the reasons for the tragedy during the birth of an important client. Now Lera can lose everything: her family, her job, and even her freedom. Will she be able to find the strength to revive her life without letting what is dear to her fall apart?
title: Дыши

overview: The couple's vacation began on the paradisiacal beaches of Vietnam. But how will it end? Season 1 of the TV series "High Season" can be watched online. On the eve of leaving home, Misha and Anya's plans are unexpectedly interfered with. The girl meets her ex — and, as she thought, dead — boyfriend Sasha Sakhar, and soon after disappears. The police refuse to help Misha in the search for his beloved. His own investigation leads him to the captain of the People's Army of Vietnam, whose name is Tao. She is also trying to get the truth out of others about a personal tragedy — the death of her younger sister. The search for the culprits draws Tao and Misha into the cycle of the city's nightlife, full of carefully hidden secrets and deadly danger.

overview: After Tokyo, feelings changed, but questions remained. A year later, P thrived as a blogger, Pan and Plai as singers ... until Pan returned to Japan, not alone. Can P turn this winter into a Season of Love?

overview: When Noah's mother, Ella, falls in love with the very wealthy William, the two move from America to London to live with William and his son Nick. Upon arrival, the 18-year-old Noah meets bad boy Nick, and there is an immediate attraction between the two. Noah spends the summer adjusting to her new life, making new friends from Nick's various circles, and navigating a complicated relationship with him while they fight to keep the attraction at bay. Noah will ultimately be forced to deal with her devastating past while falling in love for the first time.

overview: Tiffany Pollard gathers around the tables of New York City's hottest restaurants with her famous friends for free-flowing conversations and cocktails.

overview: MacGyver follows the adventures of the laid-back, extremely resourceful secret agent Angus MacGyver. He prefers non-violent conflict resolution whenever possible and refuses to carry or use a gun. MacGyver works as a problem solver for the Phoenix Foundation in Los Angeles. Utilizing his education as a scientist and his experience as an operative in the Department of External Services (DXS), he is able to solve a range of problems usually with the help of his ever-present Swiss Army knife.
title: MacGyver

overview: Series following the media personality as she and her partner at the time, Carl, undergo IVF treatment in the hope of growing their family.

overview: Workplace rookie Wang Cuihua unexpectedly finds herself inside the plot of a transmigration novel, where she meets Zhang San, another time-traveler. One is a novice struggling to fight against fate in the workplace; the other is a domineering king who has spent ten years lying low, hiding his achievements. Together, the two, armed with knowledge of the script, begin a series of strategic maneuvers to survive. Tests confirm that the secondary female character, Xie Yong'er, is a transmigrator from an even lower level of the story world. Wang Cuihua and Zhang San prepare drought-resistant crops in advance, recruit talented individuals, stabilize the borderlands, and win over Xie Yong'er, all while defeating the Duke of Duan. Victory seems within reach, but Xiahou Dan (Zhang San) suffers from a long-term, incurable head illness. Only then does Yu Wanyin (Wang Cuihua) realize that the anonymous guest had long prophesied that only one of them could survive. Back when Xiahou Dan spared her life, he missed his best chance to survive. Now, Yu Wanyin makes the same choice to save Xiahou Dan. The weak Qiang Kingdom frequently sends assassins to defeat the Great Xia. When a mute assassin attempts to poison Xiahou Dan, Yu Wanyin uses poison to counter poison, curing his head illness and saving his life. In the end, Yu Wanyin and Xiahou Dan both survive, witnessing the prosperous era they had worked so hard to achieve. Adapted from the novel of the same name by Qi Yingjun.
title: How Dare You!?

overview: Soulful compositions. Box-office hits. A timeless legacy. This documentary series traces the lives of the Roshans and their unforgettable work.
title: The Roshans

overview: Even if hardship and misfortune always accompany life, the youths who have walked with their middle finger raised now seek someone to lean on wholeheartedly, wanting to find a person to rely on as if they were to fall. Dreaming of becoming a film director one day, Kim Moo Bi, an assistant director, wants to follow in her father's footsteps, who worked as a filming crew member. After entering the film industry, she quietly honed her skills, not drawing attention to herself in the eyes of others. On the other hand, Ko Gyeom rose from being a supporting actor to becoming a film critic. He meets Moo Bi on the set of an interview film, eventually starting their own love story.
title: Melo Movie

overview: Halfway Across the Galaxy and Turn Left is a 1985 novel by Australian children's author Robin Klein which also became a children's television series. The story focuses on an alien family who seek refuge on Earth, in the small town of Bellwood. Klein also wrote a sequel novel called Turn Right for Zyrgon. The story was made into a television series in 1991-1992. It was very popular in Australiaand aired on CITV and TCC in the UK and also in other parts of Europe and there are many fansites. The series is not available on DVD, though in the early 1990s several episodes were released on VHS in the UK. These can often be found for sale on eBay. The TV-show had 28 episodes, split into 2 story arcs. The first story arc stayed close to the novel, the second arc had new stories written, some of which would end up incorporated into the sequel novel, Turn Right for Zyrgon. The entire series was filmed in Melbourne, Australia. Zyrgon, and the family home interior were shot on the Crawford Productions sound-stage. The town of Bellwood was shot inWilliamstown. The family home exterior is located in Surrey Hills. The props for the space raft and other sets were kept in the Crawford Productions lot for a couple of years following production, however, they were eventually dismantled and destroyed. The series was repeated in the UK between 2007-2008 on a digital children's channel.
title: Halfway Across the Galaxy and Turn Left

overview: The definitive GAA sports series returns to TG4 for a 23rd series. The series' hour-long format has proven a huge success, bringing each player's personal stories to the screen. The series features eight Laochra with star quality and reveals deeper, fresh and sometimes genuine unexpected insights into the lives of these icons. While their sporting careers continue to provide the backdrop to the story, the series travels well beyond the four white lines. Gripping personal stories will compel viewers to travel towards the territory unique to the GAA television landscape.
title: Laochra Gael

overview: Maria Trifonova is a real "old—school" mathematician, the last "Teacher of the Year of the USSR". In her lessons, children are not only afraid to reach for their phones, but they don't even breathe without permission. Unexpectedly, the heroine finds herself in an elite school — all for the chance to establish a relationship with her only granddaughter, whom she has not seen for many years due to a conflict with her daughter. In her new world, Maria will face an unusual approach to learning: freedom, technology, and the spoiled children of the rich reign here. Now the "Soviet teacher" will have to instill a love of mathematics in the modern generation and find a common language with the closest people.

Tune in for collector cars that are out of this world as Barrett-Jackson lands in Scottsdale, Arizona. Barrett-Jackson is in Scottsdale with some of the best cars the auction has seen yet. From collector classics to modern marvels, Scottsdale has it all.

From finance and health to consumer affairs and property, the new bulletin will also include interactive panel chats, special reports and feature segments on the stories that matter to all Australians from 7NEWS' national news desk and team of reporters
title: Seven's National News at Noon

overview: How was life in the olden days? What did they eat? How did they play? And eh... where did they go to the toilet...!? Welcome to Siar Linn, the game show where we explore a different era of history with tasks and challenges. Our History Squad plays 'Siar Linn' by exploring this era with the help of their 'Adventure Avatars'! The aim of the game? Win as many gold badges as possible.
title: Siar Linn

overview: 'Mo Pheata' is a series about young people and their pets. Our presenters Séaghan and Faith Leigh will meet with young people and their pets from all over the country. They'll have lots of fun as their pets compete and learn how to care for their own pets at home.
title: Mo Pheata

overview: Explores the harrowing claims of child abuse in the sleepy town of Wenatchee, WA. In 1995, the wholesome "Apple Capital of the World" was rocked by appalling allegations that adults in the town were running a child sex trafficking ring dubbed "The Circle," which abused more than 60 children at various locations around the town. After dozens of arrests, more than 29,000 counts of child abuse and 1,000 combined hours of prison sentences, the truth emerged: None of it ever happened.
title: In the Valley of Sin

overview: Hosted by Anderson Cooper
title: AC360 Later
